title: cananga schomburgkiana
intro: Cananga schomburgkiana, commonly known as the yellow cananga or Macapá, is a plant species belonging to the family Annonaceae. The health benefits of Cananga schomburgkiana include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it useful in aromatherapy for reducing anxiety and stress. Bioactive constituents of Cananga schomburgkiana include geraniol, linalool, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
